name: awesome-niri
desc: An awesome list for niri related projects [Maintainer - @Vortriz]

resources.name: niri Wiki
resources.desc: The official wiki, containing installation instructions and usage guides.

resources.name: niri Matrix Channel
resources.desc: The official Matrix channel, where you can ask questions and get help from the community.

resources.name: niri Discord server
resources.desc: A community maintained Discord server.

resources.name: niri subreddit
resources.desc: A community driven subreddit.

resources.name: Community Packages
resources.desc: A list of community maintained packages for niri.

resources.name: niri-flake
resources.desc: A Nix flake with cached binary builds and batteries-included modules (actively maintained fork of sodiboo/niri-flake).

resources.name: niri-nix
resources.desc: A Nix flake with cached binary builds and freeform config.

resources.name: niri-companion
resources.desc: A toolkit that adds extra functionality.

resources.name: niri-scripts
resources.desc: A collection of scripts. Notably allows setting wallpaper per workspace.

resources.name: niri tweaks
resources.desc: A collection of scripts. Notably includes a script which allows tiling N windows before scrolling new ones.

resources.name: Nirius
resources.desc: Utility commands.

resources.name: piri
resources.desc: A collection of plugins making use of niri IPC.

resources.name: miri
resources.desc: A niri extension adding per-workspace tiling layouts, such as Master Stack, similar to hyprland or mangowm.

resources.name: ndrop
resources.desc: Emulate tdrop.

resources.name: nfsm
resources.desc: Fullscreen manager.

resources.name: niri-empty
resources.desc: Execute a shell command when focusing an empty workspace.

resources.name: niri-float-sticky
resources.desc: A utility to make floating windows visible across all workspaces — similar to "sticky windows" in other compositors.

resources.name: niri-pip
resources.desc: Sticky Picture-in-Picture and floating-window control.

resources.name: niri-ror
resources.desc: Focuses an app if it's open, or starts a new instance if not. With advanced window matching and multi-instance cycling.

resources.name: niri-scratchpad
resources.desc: Scratchpad support.

resources.name: niri-scratchpad-rs
resources.desc: Dynamic scratchpads.

resources.name: niri-sidebar
resources.desc: Manage windows using a floating sidebar.

resources.name: nirimap
resources.desc: A minimal workspace minimap overlay.

resources.name: nsticky
resources.desc: A utility to make windows visible across all workspaces.

resources.name: oniri
resources.desc: A tool that automatically maximizes the only window in a workspace.

resources.name: wl-freeze
resources.desc: Utility to suspend a game process and other programs.

resources.name: niri-session-manager
resources.desc: Automatically save and restore windows.

resources.name: nirinit
resources.desc: Session manager that automatically saves and restores your window layout.

resources.name: swaytreesave
resources.desc: CLI to save and load your compositors tree/layout.

resources.name: hyprlax
resources.desc: Smooth parallax wallpaper daemon.

resources.name: pandora
resources.desc: Parallax-scrolling wallpaper daemon for Wayland.

resources.name: wayvid
resources.desc: A dynamic video wallpaper engine for Wayland compositors.

resources.name: Anyrun
resources.desc: A Wayland native krunner-like runner, made with customizability in mind. Provides niri-focus plugin.

resources.name: IIO-Niri
resources.desc: Listen to iio-sensor-proxy and update niri output orientation depending on the accelerometer orientation.

resources.name: kunai
resources.desc: Automatically switch keyboard layouts based on which physical keyboard is being used.

resources.name: NASW
resources.desc: Automatically switch audio based on active windows.

resources.name: niri-autoselect-portal
resources.desc: Always autoselect the dynamic cast target without any prompts.

resources.name: niri-screensaver
resources.desc: Idle-aware terminal screensaver for niri, driven by TerminalTextEffects, with an optional Noctalia plugin for IdleService integration.

resources.name: nirilayout
resources.desc: Quickly switch output configuration between different layouts.

resources.name: nirimon
resources.desc: A TUI monitor configuration tool with visual layout, drag-and-drop, and profile management (profile schema compliant with hyprmon).

resources.name: niriSKL.nvim
resources.desc: A Neovim plugin that maintains your latin keyboard layout of choice for NORMAL mode and restores the layout you had when in INSERT mode.

resources.name: Stasis
resources.desc: A modern Wayland idle manager with smart timeouts, media awareness, and app-specific inhibition.

resources.name: system76-scheduler-niri
resources.desc: A simple daemon to update the foreground process of system76-scheduler based on the focused window.

resources.name: utsushot
resources.desc: Supersampled Wayland screenshots via a temporary high-resolution phantom output.

resources.name: vim-niri-nav
resources.desc: Seamless navigation between niri windows and (neo)vim splits with the same key bindings.

resources.name: arbtt-capture-wl
resources.desc: Time tracker utility arbtt ported to Wayland.

resources.name: niri-cwd
resources.desc: A program to print the focused window's working directory.

resources.name: niri-screen-time
resources.desc: A utility that collects information about how much time you spend in each application.

resources.name: niri-screenshot-tools
resources.desc: A program that sends screenshots taken in niri to an annotator or uploads them to a server.

resources.name: niri-settings
resources.desc: Basic configuration GUI for niri config.

resources.name: nirimod
resources.desc: A visual, interactive configuration interface.

resources.name: Nirimation
resources.desc: A host for custom shaders to be used as animations.

resources.name: shaders
resources.desc: A collection of custom shaders.

resources.name: ashell
resources.desc: A ready to go Wayland status bar.

resources.name: bar-rs
resources.desc: A simple status bar, written using iced-rs.

resources.name: eww-niri-workspaces
resources.desc: A Rust binary that outputs workspace information from niri-ipc to be consumed by eww.

resources.name: i3bar-river
resources.desc: A port of i3bar for Wayland compositors, to be used with something like i3status-rust.

resources.name: Ignis
resources.desc: A widget framework for building desktop shells, written and configurable in Python.

resources.name: Ironbar
resources.desc: A customisable Wayland GTK bar written in Rust.

resources.name: Niri Taskbar
resources.desc: Provides a Waybar taskbar module for niri.

resources.name: niri-ribbon
resources.desc: A viewport mini-map widget for the Noctalia shell that tracks off-screen windows in real-time.

resources.name: niri_window_buttons
resources.desc: A Waybar module for displaying and managing traditional window buttons.

resources.name: vibepanel
resources.desc: A GTK4 panel for Wayland with integrated notifications, OSD, and quick settings.

resources.name: Waybar
resources.desc: Highly customizable Wayland bar based on GTK.

resources.name: waybar-niri-windows
resources.desc: A module for Waybar that displays a focus indicator for the current workspace.

resources.name: Delta Shell
resources.desc: A desktop shell based on AGS with many features.

resources.name: desktop-shell
resources.desc: Custom AGS shell for Wayland compositors supporting wayland-layer-shell.

resources.name: Dux Shell
resources.desc: Quickshell based shell featuring Material 3 design principles, with a heavy focus on functionality and customizability.

resources.name: Exo
resources.desc: A Material 3 inspired desktop shell created with Ignis.

resources.name: Glimpse
resources.desc: A niri-first Wayland desktop shell toolkit with a panel, wallpaper, lock screen, night light, and idle management.

resources.name: GPUi Shell
resources.desc: A GPUI based shell written in Rust.

resources.name: IgnisNiriShell
resources.desc: An Ignis based shell.

resources.name: iNiR
resources.desc: end-4's quickshell config modified to work with niri.

resources.name: Niri GTK
resources.desc: GTK bindings to niri IPC.

resources.name: Noctalia
resources.desc: A sleek, customizable desktop shell crafted for Wayland.

resources.name: qml-niri
resources.desc: A QML plugin for interacting with niri via its IPC protocol.

resources.name: niri on Cosmic
resources.desc: A Cosmic extension that allows niri as a session option, allowing you to use niri with the Cosmic desktop environment.

resources.name: niri on LXQt
resources.desc: LXQt is a lightweight Qt-based desktop environment that allows setting niri as compositor, while its modules can also be used standalone in niri-session.

resources.name: CachyOS
resources.desc: An Arch Linux based distribution focused around gaming, performance, and being user-friendly. It provides niri as an install option via its installer.

resources.name: KaOS
resources.desc: An independent, built from-scratch Linux distribution, focused on Qt. niri and Noctalia are shipped as the default desktop environment.

resources.name: Pika OS
resources.desc: PikaOS is a Debian sid based Linux distribution focused on gaming and performance optimization, which provides a niri edition ISO.

resources.name: Setup Showcase
resources.desc: A showcase of niri setups, where users can share their configurations and get inspiration from others.

resources.name: OOTB setups
resources.desc: A collection of out-of-the-box niri configurations that can be easily installed to get a fully functional setup quickly.
